Delicious Beautiful Cakes!
Aug 2024 • Family
We have eaten at their cafe as well as ordered custom-made desserts for our functions—truly cannot say enough positive things about this bakery!

To celebrate my MIL’s 80th birthday, our family had a destination celebration in Vietnam, and we celebrated the entire day!

- Mango cupcakes for breakfast 
- Red Velvet cake for lunch
- Strawberry Cream cake for dinner

S’Patisserie offered excellent customer service from inquiry to pick up. Being overseas, it was very much appreciated that the bakery was easily accessible for communication via Facebook, and they always responded in a timely manner. They worked with me to create a creative dessert menu for all three meals, and they were extremely helpful in providing coolers for transporting the cakes from Hanoi to Ha Noi Long Bay. 

Most importantly, the cupcakes and both cakes were absolutely stunning! I was so pleased with the outcome, and everyone (15 of us) loved the desserts, especially the birthday lady! 

I highly recommend S’Patisserie!
